headline: Chinese visitors down 56%, Japanese tourism still strong; Taiwanese, Korean, European and American travellers fill the gap | International
summary: Chinese travel demand to Japan is weak as bilateral relations show no sign of improving, a Japanese media analysis reported. Japan hopes Taiwanese, Korean, European and American travellers will fill the gap.
why: Inbound tourism spending supports Japanese hotels, retail and transport companies, so a drop in Chinese visitors affects their revenues. Japan's tourism sector is sensitive to diplomatic relations.
